title: 機械力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machines I
keywords: Motion of rigid body 2.Impact 3.Work and energy 4.Friction 5.Moment of inertia
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the kinematics of rigid bodies when forces and moments of force act on them. (2) learn the concepts of momentum, work, and energy. (3) learn about machines in which friction is utilized.
advice: This is a basic course on the dynamics of machines. We will cover the following topics: 1. Kinematics of rigid bodies 2. Dynamics of impact 3. Work and energy 4. Dynamics of friction 5. SImple machines If time permits, students will also learn about advanced issues not covered in the textbooks, such as three-dimensional motion. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Each student is expected to solve the exercises by himself or herself. Students should pay attention to the teacher's instructions in class. The schedule of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from class, as they may miss handouts.
books: Textbooks: (in Japanese) Reference books: Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics [Wiley] Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Industrial Mechanics I and II. Enough skill in mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector inner/outcome calculations). Basic knowledge of mechanics (kinematics and moment of force). How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the meaning of terms and to use SI units correctly.
Be able to explain the kinetics of rigid bodies.
Be able to explain changes in the motion of rigid bodies when they impact each other.
Be able to describe the energy of rigid bodies in motion.
Be able to analyze the motion of a machine using friction.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the concepts of terms such as momentum, energy, conserved force, and center of percussion, and correctly use SI units related to mechanics. (2) Express the three-dimensional motion of rigid bodies by equations and explain their behavior. (3) Analyze oblique impact and non-central impact. (4) Calculate the energy of rigid bodies in three-dimensional motion. (5) Formulate equations of motion for machines using frictional forces and explain their motions.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the meaning of terms such as momentum, linear impulse, energy, conserved force, and coefficient of restitution, and correctly use SI units for velocity, acceleration, angular velocity, momentum, angular momentum, work, energy, and power. (2) Express the planar motion of rigid bodies with equations. (3) Analyze the direct central impact of rigid bodies. (4) Calculate the energy of rigid bodies in planar motion. (5) Describe the frictional force in mathematical terms.
